ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with a macro-level ratio of approximately 65% low-intensity (dark) to 35% high-intensity (white) pixels on the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity zone spanning the central fluke and interior trailing edges. High-intensity regions are localized on distal lobes. Left lobe (viewer perspective) contains three discrete low-intensity circular spots on a white field. Right lobe contains irregular low-intensity mottling concentrated along the trailing boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated aperture angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serrations along both trailing edges; peaks and valleys show pixel-amplitude variations between 4 and 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the outer edges, terminating in highly irregular, jagged distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of three distinct, small circular low-intensity clusters on the high-intensity zone of the left lobe; diffuse low-intensity clusters on the distal right lobe near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; distinct indentation (notched gap) located on the right lobe trailing edge approximately two-thirds from the median notch.
